div.div:
مَسْهَجٌ [like مَسْهَكٌ] A place where the wind passes along [or blows violently]. (AA, S, O, K.) AA cites, as an ex., the saying, “إِذَا هَبَطْنَ مُسْتَحَارً مَسْهَجَا
” [When they descend into, or enter, a place of confusion, or perplexity, where one is unable to see his right course, a place where the wind blows, or blows violently]. (S, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
